core_memory.user_introduction: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been searching for a coffee machine that suits his lifestyle and design preferences.
core_memory.user_description: The user received a damaged espresso machine with a dented stainless-steel body and sharp edges. The outer box had crushed corners and was slightly caved in. The user is seeking assistance with a replacement or repair.
